frostbell_first.name: First Frostbell
frostbell_first.description: The bell taken from Krampus Keep's ruins. It hums with a cold that has nothing to do with temperature.

frostbell_second.name: Second Frostbell
frostbell_second.description: Recovered from the Bell Thief. When held near the first, they ring softly on their own — a fifth apart.

frostbell_third.name: Third Frostbell
frostbell_third.description: Taken from the Echo Cult's chapel. The priest let you have it. That worries you more than a fight would have.

frostbell_fourth.name: Fourth Frostbell
frostbell_fourth.description: Hidden in the vault beneath the Ancient Shrine. It is shaped like a Pokémon's rib.

frostbell_fifth.name: Fifth Frostbell
frostbell_fifth.description: Pried from the Herald's frozen altar. It is warm. Every other bell you carry has gone cold.
